$comment: What public text may not say. Both SDKs, their spec and their packages are public; the services behind the API are not, and their names, repositories, branches, tickets and source paths together would map them. `denied_words_sha256`: the SHA-256 of each word that may not appear, lower case (hashed so that this file does not publish them); a text's words are its runs of letters and digits joined by single hyphens, lower-cased. `denied_patterns`: regular expressions that may not match, case-sensitive unless they say otherwise. Each SDK's public-text check reads this file: sproutsdata-py `scripts/check_public_text.py`, sproutsdata-js `scripts/check-public-text.mjs`.
